title: Fibre dimension bounds descend to a finite stage
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(S_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and limit $S$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $(X_i\to S_i)_{i\in I}$ be an inverse system of finite-type morphisms [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] such that for $i\le j$ the canonical map [def-pc-fibre-product] $X_j\to X_i\times_{S_i}S_j$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $X\to S$ be its limit. Fix an integer $d\ge0$. If every scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] of $X\to S$ has topological dimension at most $d$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], then for some $i$ every fibre of $X_i\to S_i$ has dimension at most $d$.

proof.text: Choose $i_0\in I$. Apply the compatible affine-chart-system lemma, obtaining the cofinal tail $J$, finite chart sets $A,B$, finite-type maps $A_{i,a}\to C_{i,a}$, surjective tensor comparison maps, and limit charts $W_a\to V_{b(a)}$ represented by $A_a\to C_a$. All its hypotheses are precisely the system hypotheses here.

source.place: Tag 05M5, lemma-limit-dimension; assembly of the extracted affine-chart and chart-bound synchronization lemmas

proof.text: Apply part (1) of the open-chart fibre-bound lemma to the singleton inverse system consisting of $X\to S$, with the finite covers $W_a,V_{b(a)}$. Their transition conditions are identities, and part (1) requires no finite-type assumption. The given bound on all fibres of $X\to S$ therefore bounds all chart fibres. By the affine fibre-product formula, these are $\operatorname{Spec}(C_a\otimes_{A_a}\kappa(\mathfrak p))$ for primes $\mathfrak p$ of $A_a$.

source.place: Tag 05M5, lemma-limit-dimension; assembly of the extracted affine-chart and chart-bound synchronization lemmas

proof.text: For each $a\in A$, apply the existing affine limit fibre-dimension bound to $(A_{i,a}\to C_{i,a})_{i\in J}$. The index set is small, nonempty and directed; Step 1 gives finite type, surjective comparisons and the required colimits, and Step 2 gives the bound at every prime of $A_a$. Obtain $i_a\in J$ with every fibre of $W_{i_a,a}\to V_{i_a,b(a)}$ bounded by $d$, using the affine fibre-product formula again.

source.place: Tag 05M5, lemma-limit-dimension; assembly of the extracted affine-chart and chart-bound synchronization lemmas

proof.text: Apply part (2) of the open-chart fibre-bound lemma to the system on $J$. Step 1 supplies its finite covers, compatible restricted maps (the charts are open inverse images, so transitions carry $W_{j,a}$ into $W_{i,a}$ and $V_{j,b(a)}$ into $V_{i,b(a)}$) and closed comparisons. Each chart morphism $g_{i,a}:W_{i,a}\to V_{i,b(a)}$ is locally of finite type: affine opens $U\subseteq W_{i,a}$, $V'\subseteq V_{i,b(a)}$ with $g_{i,a}(U)\subseteq V'$ are affine opens of $X_i$, $S_i$ with $f_i(U)\subseteq V'$, so the affine-pairs criterion applied to the finite-type $f_i$ makes $\mathcal O(V')\to\mathcal O(U)$ of finite type, and the same criterion applied to $g_{i,a}$ gives the claim. Step 3 supplies the individual chart stages. It gives a common $j\in J$ where every fibre of $X_j\to S_j$ has dimension at most $d$, as required. If $A$ is empty its empty-cover case applies.
